name: TIDTABELL flatwoven rug, beige, 170x240 (IKEA Israel)

warm-modern.reason: Estimate: 100% wool flatweave, flat and low, no pattern or fringe, warm beige. Size 170x240 is under the 230-240x220-250 spec for the dining line, so it is a size compromise. Colour is read from the name, not measured.

safety.source: IKEA Israel product page: 'tested and approved for home use'; no OEKO-TEX statement on the page

notes: Read from the IKEA Israel product page on 2026-11-19. 80% natural-fibre rule met (100% wool pile, cotton warp). Other sizes on the same listing: 133x195 (the page shows a 200 ILS difference next to it, ambiguous, price not confirmed). Same rug also serves the work-room `rug` line (170x240 is the exact spec) and a kids rug (133x195 variant). Sold by IKEA, so alternative-only under the studio rules unless the owner allows it. Colour hex is an estimate from the colour name; images were not downloaded (no shell). Shipping to Israel: cheapest = IKEA Israel standard home delivery or store pickup (price and time not verified); fastest = not published, stock is 'checking availability' on the page. ANTI-SLIP: IKEA recommends STOPP FILT underlay (69 ILS for 165x235). Image rights: IKEA product photos, no licence stated, so unclear.
